info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Corporate Relation Investor Relation-spec
info.description: The Corporate Relation Management API facilitates the establishment of corporate relations specifically tailored for investor interactions. This endpoint allows businesses to create and manage investor relation specifications, ensuring effective communication and engagement with their investors. Typical consumers of this API include finance and investor relations teams looking to streamline their processes and enhance relationship management. By leveraging this functionality, organizations can enhance their investor outreach and maintain transparent connections with stakeholders.

post.summary: Create a new Investor Relations entry.
post.description: This API endpoint allows you to create a new entry in the Investor Relations section for corporate relations. It requires the relevant data to properly record the investor's information, which will help in maintaining and improving communication with investors.
